text:
Yesterday you were born, and you will die tomorrow.

for tan brief to be, ¿who you dio life?

¿for to live tan poco estás lucida,

and for no to be nada estás lozana?


if you engañó his hermosura vana,

bien presto the verás desvanecida,

because in your hermosura is escondida

the ocasión of morir death temprana.


when you corte the robusta hand,

ley of the agricultura permitida,

grosero aliento acabará your suerte.


no salgas, that you wait algún tirano;

dilata your nacer for your life,

that anticipas your to be for your death.

translation.title: A a rose
